records.title: Ship 42’s tower catch on Flight 15
records.curation_note: After returning from orbit on 14 November 2026, Ship 42 descends beside the launch tower at Starbase, Texas. Its engines are still firing as the arms reach underneath the spacecraft.

records.title: Before birth, seen with sound
records.curation_note: Two ultrasound views show a human fetus at 12 weeks, as identified by the contributor. The bright outlines come from returning sound waves.

records.title: Twelve seconds at Kitty Hawk
records.curation_note: Orville Wright lies at the controls as the Flyer lifts off on 17 December 1903. Wilbur runs beside it. This first flight covered 120 feet in 12 seconds.

records.title: Gandhi picks up salt at Dandi
records.curation_note: On 6 April 1930, Gandhi gathered salt at Dandi in defiance of British salt law. This surviving slide pairs the scene with a written title.
